questions.prompt: What owns the learner-facing exchange in this example?
questions.explanation: The conversation protocol owns the learner-facing exchange.

questions.prompt: Explain why a conversation protocol and a tool protocol are distinct.
questions.rubric: The answer should distinguish the application-facing conversation from downstream tool invocation.
questions.reference_answer: The conversation protocol coordinates prompts and updates between the application and agent, while a tool protocol lets the agent invoke external capabilities.
questions.explanation: The layers cooperate but have different owners and responsibilities.

questions.prompt: Which items belong to the conversation layer?
questions.explanation: Prompts and agent updates cross the conversation boundary.
The prompt starts the work and the result completes the exchange.

questions.prompt: Does a tool service automatically own the learner conversation?
questions.explanation: Tool access and conversation ownership are separate concerns.
